root_cause_description: Asynchronous detached-thread use-after-free in HttpClient::SendRequestAsync triggered by MatchResultsOutbox disk recovery during rapid DedicatedServer cycling

experiment_a_teardown_order.hypothesis: Client destruction preceding server shutdown causes peer flush to closed socket handles
experiment_a_teardown_order.variant_a_existing_order: FAIL (100% crash rate when chained after DedicatedServerTest, exit 0xc0000409)
experiment_a_teardown_order.variant_b_server_first: FAIL (100% crash rate, crashed in Section 2 with LatBot_4, exit 0xc0000409)

experiment_b_port_recycling.hypothesis: Rapid reuse of UDP port 17777 causes Winsock address binding collisions and kernel buffer leaks
experiment_b_port_recycling.variant_dynamic_sequential_ports: FAIL (crashed in Section 7 at Client #12 on port 18022)

root_cause_forensics.mechanism: std::thread(...).detach() in SendRequestAsync captures 'this' without lifetime binding to HttpClient destructor
root_cause_forensics.trigger_condition: MatchResultsOutbox discovers pending JSON file written by DedicatedServerTest, repeatedly enqueuing HTTP requests on 25+ short-lived DedicatedServer instances

recommended_production_scope: Replace detached std::thread in HttpClient with tracked/joined thread pool or std::jthread
Isolate outbox directory in test execution to temporary sandbox paths
